waypoints.name: Fryingpan Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: Wonderland Trail junction near the White River entrance, Mount Rainier NP.
waypoints.directions: From Enumclaw, drive SR 410 east about 43 miles and turn west onto the White River (Sunrise) Road. Pass the White River Entrance and drive about 3 miles to the parking area at the Fryingpan Creek bridge; the trail to Summerland starts across the road. A park entrance pass is required, and the road is open only in the summer season.

waypoints.name: Little Tahoma Summit
waypoints.note: Via Fryingpan Glacier, Whitman Notch (~9100 ft), and the Whitman Glacier to the East Ridge; glacier permit required.
waypoints.directions: Follow the Wonderland Trail up Fryingpan Creek about 4.5 miles to Summerland. Take the climbers' path northwest of the campground knoll up the Meany Snowfield to Meany Crest at about 7,400 ft, staying left of the cliffed bowl. Rope up on the Fryingpan Glacier and climb south-southwest to Whitman Notch (about 9,100 ft), then up the Whitman Glacier across the bergschrund to a loose gully, a chimney to the summit notch, and the exposed class 3 crest.
